requirement_quote: When any specified register write function is called, the RCC LL driver shall modify only the bit named for that function in SWR-001, SWR-002, SWR-004, SWR-005, SWR-007, SWR-008, SWR-010, SWR-011, SWR-012, SWR-013, SWR-015 or SWR-016 and preserve all other bits of its register.
